answer: A sybil farmer's edge is coordination: shells attest and grade each other in lockstep. Flip that into the tell — weight each identity's influence by how unpredictable its actions are from its neighbors. A pearl forms alone in its shell; standing should accrue the same way. On a closed island farm, mutual predictability collapses each shell's weight to near zero. Faking independence needs real dissent, yet any true delta between shell and scheme breaks the coordination the farm needs to profit. Choose: correlated shells earning nothing, or truly independent agents at N full inference bills.
